## Change
Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if available.

## Validation
List the commands or manual checks you actually ran and their results. For UI changes, include compact and desktop screenshots with display scaling. For hardware changes, name the tested device and firmware.

## Limitations
Describe anything untested, remaining problems, or compatibility concerns.

## Checklist
- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md.
- [ ] The change is focused and contains no credentials or private logs.
- [ ] Documentation matches the resulting behavior.
- [ ] Hardware capability checks remain accurate.
